title: Structural stability of cylindrical transonic shocks to the three-dimensional Zeldovich-von Neumann-Döring combustion equations
summary: We address the structural stability of transonic shock solutions to the Zeldovich-von Neumann-Döring (ZND) combustion equations in a cylindrical domain under three-dimensional perturbations of the incoming supersonic flow and exit pressure. The perturbed transonic shock is completely free and its strength and position are uniquely determined by the incoming flow and the exit pressure. The solution shares the same regularity for the velocity, the pressure, the entropy and the fraction of unburned gas. The main difficulties are that the shock front is a free boundary to be determined…
